author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). XRPC param strings now promote to validated proto_blue_syntax newtypes, completing the surface-area work that #3 started.

Code change in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs:
  - New `string_format_constructor(format) -> Option<&'static str>` helper: returns the source-code path for the newtype's `::new(&str) -> Result<_, _>` constructor (e.g. \`\"proto_blue_syntax::Did::new\"\`) or None for plain String. Mirror of `string_format_to_rust`'s mapping.
  - `param_type_to_rust` restored to format-aware mapping (was String-everywhere as a #3 workaround). Now mirrors `type_to_rust`'s `LexString::format → newtype` dispatch.
  - `generate_to_query_params` String-arm: emits `QueryValue::String(v.to_string())` instead of `v.clone()`. Works uniformly for String (Display = identity) and any proto_blue_syntax newtype (Display = inner string). Same fix in the `Array<String>` inner.
  - `generate_params_from_ctx` String-arm: when format → newtype, emits `ctx.params.get(key).and_then(|v| <Newtype>::new(v).ok())`. For `Array<String-with-format>`, emits `split(',').map(<Newtype>::new).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>().ok()` — propagates parse failure as None so a malformed query param returns None for the field, matching the rest of the parser's Option-on-failure shape.
  - All non-string param types unchanged.

Wire format unchanged. Public API breaking on proto-blue-api: every method-call NSID with a typed param now expects `proto_blue_syntax::*` newtype values from callers (was: bare String). Same migration shape as #3 — `Did::new(&did_str)?` etc. before passing into a generated XRPC call.

Code volume: 322 lexicons → 368 generated files; 220 files in the bundled corpus changed. Each change is the param Field type + the matching `to_query_params` / `params_from_ctx` line.

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen                                  PASS (19 tests)
  cargo build --workspace                                           PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                            PASS (67 suites, 0 failures)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings             PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                           PASS
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen wild_corpus_compiles -- --ignored (against bundled symlink): PASS in 19.9s — stress-tests that the regenerated 368-file output rustc-compiles end-to-end with the new helper templates.

Behavioural change: yes, public-API-breaking on proto-blue-api's XRPC method surface. Wire serialisation unchanged. Server-side handler authors (anyone using the `register()` helpers under the `server` feature) will need to handle the case where params fail newtype validation — currently surfaces as None for that field, same as a missing param.

Category: A (root-cause) — replaced the param-side String fallback (the #3 follow-up) across the entire helper-template surface in one bump.

The audit's "String everywhere it should be a newtype" concern is now closed across BOTH generator paths (object fields via #3, XRPC params via this) AND the hand-written API surface (Agent/Session/LabelerOpts via #6). Callers can't accidentally pass random strings anywhere a typed value is semantically expected.
